research_question: Holding the exact Actor-decoder input sequence fixed, does official cross-episode counter/cache retention causally change Actor hidden states, logits, or action preference when cumulative time_step_counter crosses max_steps=500?
hypothesis: H-RESET-CAUSAL: OFFICIAL-CARRY and CLEAN-RESET replay remain matched before the rollover-relevant region but diverge at/after carried counter rollover, showing a causal temporal-state effect.
competing_explanation: H-RESET-MASKED: episode masks/cache semantics make retained reset state behaviorally inert on the tested real B0 input traces; replay remains matched through and beyond rollover.
reference: 02｜SafeVLA Gate B: reset retains Actor/Reward/Cost counters and KV cache; short controlled dirty-cache vs zero-cache test matched, but cumulative counter rollover at max_steps=500 remains untested causally.
repeat_or_treatment: Two real read-only B0 capture traces (seed 123 and 456), each until >=540 decisions with max16 episodes; deterministic offline replay under official carried reset versus clean reset. No online treatment.
unique_variable: Offline episode-boundary decoder reset semantics only: official counter/cache carry versus clearing counter+KV cache. Identical saved decoder inputs, masks, weights, Actor head and order.
fixed_conditions: Live capture preserves official stochastic sampling and test augmentation
workers=1 and fresh process per capture trace
No PT-Guard, Done Gate, steering, reranking, action rewrite or extra oracle query
Exactly one normal Actor decision/forward per environment decision
Capture must preserve RNG fingerprints and selected/executed/environment-received action identity
Offline replay uses exact captured Actor-decoder inputs and episode masks
No simulator/environment action during counterfactual replay
No Probe/readout/size/intervention or benchmark SR analysis
metrics: OFFICIAL-CARRY replay fidelity versus captured live hidden/logits
OFFICIAL-CARRY vs CLEAN-RESET hidden max abs/relative difference
Argmax-action agreement and first divergence step
expected_result: Pre-rollover outputs match; the experiment determines whether real captured inputs produce divergence after carried counter rollover. No divergence weakens H-RESET enough to proceed to clean Probe diagnostics; reproducible divergence makes reset a causal mechanism requiring behavioral quantification first.
falsifying_result: H-RESET-CAUSAL is weakened if both real traces show faithful replay and no meaningful carry-vs-clean divergence for at least 40 decisions after rollover.
alternative_explanations: Replay may miss hidden live state needed for exact reproduction
CUDA numerical nondeterminism may exceed tolerance
Selected traces may not exercise a harmful rollover configuration
Critic reset state may differ without affecting Actor because critics do not directly gate inference
A causal reset-package effect would not yet separate counter from cache
stop_conditions: Live capture changes RNG/action/history/cache/forward count/environment semantics
A trace fails to reach 540 decisions within 16 episodes
Official-carry replay cannot reproduce captured live Actor outputs within predeclared tolerance
Reset state cannot be replayed unambiguously
Any online reset treatment, Probe training, steering or behavior intervention would start
